transcript.text: Thank you all. Simone's recommendation is sound and I'm going to adopt it as the basis for our plan. Here's my proposed allocation: Of the 450 currently released modules, allocate 120 to Model Y (requiring 1 module each = 120 modules) and 330 to Model X (covering 165 Model X drives at 2 modules each). For the 150 recoverable held modules, allocate all 150 to Model X (covering 75 additional Model X drives). That gives us 240 Model X drives total (165 + 75) and 120 Model Y drives total — exactly matching our plan. This approach ensures Model Y only uses currently released modules with standard traceability documentation, while recovered modules are restricted to Model X as Simone recommended. Now, the timing concern is critical. Jon flagged that 180 Model X and all 120 Model Y are due Friday — that's 300 drives. For Friday, we'd need modules for 180 Model X (360 modules) and 120 Model Y (120 modules) = 480 modules total. We have 450 released now, so we're 30 short for Friday even before considering the Monday shipment. That means at least 30 recovered modules must be ready in time for Friday production. Mara, I need you to urgently assess whether the bake and testing can start soon enough to have at least 30 recovered modules available for Friday production. And Simone, please begin your verification of whether the held modules carry the required serialization — even though we're currently planning to restrict them to Model X, we may need that assessment if timing forces adjustments. Can I get confirmation from everyone on this allocation approach and the timing feasibility?
